description: Clarification questions are unwrapped from mangled 'What is the <whole sentence>?' forms, punctuated, capitalised, deduplicated by content overlap and capped at ten.
why_it_exists: The question list is generated by concatenating model output with an auto-generated question per missing fact, which produced near-duplicate and grammatically mangled questions in the owner's Telegram message.

questions: What is the what is the date, time, and exact location of the incident??
What is the date, time, and exact location of the incident?
Do you have photographs or video of the damage and the scene
What is the what is the date, time, and exact location of the incident??
What is the date, time, and exact location of the incident?
Do you have photographs or video of the damage and the scene

assertions: A question matching /^What is the (.+)\?$/ whose inner text contains whitespace and is longer than 30 characters is unwrapped to that inner text.
Every kept question ends in '?' or '.' and starts with a capital letter.
Two questions are near-duplicates when their significant-word signatures (words of five or more characters, stop words removed) overlap by two or more words; the longer one is kept.
Original input order is preserved among the kept questions - deduplication ranks by length but the output re-filters the cleaned list.
Blank questions are dropped and the list is capped at ten.
